clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Wizbang Cranktoggle needs his lost gaffer jacks back. The gnome inventor tossed a box of hardware into the sea during his voyage from Ironforge, and anglers can search for it along Darkshore's coast.

Wizbang Cranktoggle crossed the Great Sea from Ironforge to find quiet in Darkshore. The gnome inventor drank too much on the voyage. Leaning over the rail in a drunken haze, he lost a crate of specialized metal parts called gaffer jacks in the water near Auberdine.

Wizbang says gaffer jacks are essential precision tools. Without them, he cannot properly tune his stintle pegs or continue his delicate tinkering. Unwilling to wade into the cold surf himself, he asks local anglers to cast along Darkshore's shore and fish up the scattered parts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came to Auberdine because of the quiet. I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!
So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way. I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard! I need my gaffer jacks!
I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find my gaffer jacks, friend? Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't believe you found them! You must be the luckiest traveler in Kalimdor!
